intro: Many of our veneer patients do not live in Florida. They send photos, get a written estimate, and fly in for one Monday-to-Thursday week. It fits because our [lab is in the building](/custom-lab), so the veneers are made between visits instead of shipped. The same schedule applies to [porcelain veneers](/porcelain-veneers-miami) on a few teeth and to the 20-veneer [Smile Design](/smile-design-miami); full mouth restoration takes two weeks and All-on-X is planned separately.

visits.d: Send photos, get your written estimate within {replyHours} hours, pick a payment plan and reserve with a ${depositUsd} deposit.
visits.time: Any day, about 2 minutes of your time

visits.d: Cleaning, X-rays, scans and photos. You confirm the design with your doctor.
visits.time: About 2 hours. Rest of the day free.

visits.d: Minimal preparation, then temporaries in your approved design. Live with it Wednesday.
Veneers bonded, bite checked, {warrantyYears}-year warranty handed over in writing.
visits.time: About 2 hours. Fly home the same evening.

fromHome.title: What happens from home first
fromHome.aside: Nothing is booked until you have the number in writing. Most patients do all of this in a week of evenings.

items.d: Three photos from your phone, through the [free photo evaluation](/free-photo-evaluation). No visit, no cost.
Within {replyHours} hours in office hours, with which teeth and veneer or crown per tooth.
The total, in writing, from the [published package prices](/veneers-cost-miami). It only changes if the exam finds something new.
Pre-qualify with one of six [financing partners](/financing) with a soft credit check, or pay in full.
A ${depositUsd} deposit, applied to your treatment, holds the three visits.
Arrive Sunday evening or early Monday; home Thursday evening. You book directly, with the Hilton and Marriott partner rate.

perks.d: Three vetted hotels within 10 minutes, Hilton and Marriott at 20% off. You book directly from the list we send.
MIA is 15 minutes away. We text you the rideshare pickup spot before you land.
Uber and Lyft pick up at our front door; we send the details for each visit.
One person, by text, from first message to the flight home.
Video check-in two weeks after delivery; small adjustments are covered by the warranty anywhere.
A free day between preparation and delivery. Beach, Wynwood or just rest.

travel.title: Airport, rides and hotel, plainly
body: We are a dental clinic, not a travel agency. We send a short list of three hotels within ten minutes, two with a 20% partner rate, and you book directly; nothing travel-related is included in the price of treatment. The clinic is at 8396 SW 8th St, 15 minutes from MIA and about an hour from Fort Lauderdale, with Uber and Lyft at the door and parking at the building if you drive.

pack.title: What to pack
pack.intro: Less than you think. The clinic has everything for the visits.
items: Your written estimate and the ID you booked with.
Your medication list, and your night guard if you wear one.
Sunglasses for the free Wednesday, and a taste for soft lunches while you are in temporaries.
If you were asked to whiten first, the shade you finished at; the veneers are matched to it in the chair.

companions.title: Who can come with you
companions.body: Anyone you like. Partners, parents and friends are welcome in the waiting area and at the Visit 1 design review; during preparation and bonding they wait in the lobby. Children are welcome with an adult. Coming alone is normal too: visits are under local anesthesia, so you can take a rideshare after each one.

cities.title: Patients come from
cities.intro: Flight times, a sample Monday-to-Thursday itinerary, what it costs to come and a patient's own words, for the cities we see most. Everywhere else works the same way; send photos and we plan the week with you.

items.name: Atlanta
items.d: Under two hours nonstop. Fly in Monday morning, home Thursday evening.

items.name: Houston
items.d: About two and a half hours nonstop from Bush or Hobby.

items.name: Dallas–Fort Worth
items.d: Just under three hours nonstop from DFW.

items.name: New York
items.d: Three hours from JFK, LaGuardia or Newark, with flights every hour.

items.name: Orlando
items.d: Three and a half to four hours by car or train, or an hour by air.

items.name: Tampa
items.d: Four hours by car across Alligator Alley, or just over an hour by air.
